mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (id, user_id, role_id, tenant_id, deleted, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{roleId}, #{tenantId}, 0, #{operatorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted = 0, delete_by = NULL, delete_time = NULL, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
